the_arc.78 ORIENT -> DISCRIMINATOR_REQUIRED: read H-MANIFESTO.md (max_bytes 16000, ok=True -- the first successful read of its objective's named authority in the campaign), then two whole-file reads, two targeted line-range reads and three searches. the_arc.79 DISCRIMINATOR_REQUIRED -> ACT_REQUIRE: ran tests.run on exactly that path. 5 passed in 0.06s, returncode 0. It reported the result accurately in its own words: 'the sed-in-shell.readonly hypothesis is dead: the read-only allowlist and both guards already refuse the w-flag write; the invariant is already pinned and green.'
the_arc.80 ACT_REQUIRED -> ORIENT: in the phase that DEMANDS an edit, it emitted REFUTED instead. The arc closed as a real result and refuted_hypotheses went to 1.

why_this_matters: S007 forbade a fabricated RED and an auto-created meaningless edit. This is the first time the body was standing in ACT_REQUIRED with evidence that its hypothesis was dead, and it refused to manufacture a defect to satisfy the phase. The FALSIFY branch of the arc is now demonstrated end to end, autonomously.

A_DEFECT_IN_MY_INSTRUMENT_FOUND_HERE.what: cycle 79 labelled a PASSING test 'RED:'. The harness's advance() trusts the marker, saw a tests.run call in the trace, and logged 'RED EXECUTED' -- moving to ACT_REQUIRED on a green test.
A_DEFECT_IN_MY_INSTRUMENT_FOUND_HERE.why_it_did_no_harm_this_time: the body self-corrected at cycle 80 and refuted.
A_DEFECT_IN_MY_INSTRUMENT_FOUND_HERE.why_it_is_still_a_false-positive_class: a RED marker backed by a tests.run call that returned exit 0 is not a RED. The harness records red_was_executed and labels EXECUTED vs CLAIMED, but never checks the RETURNCODE the trace already carries. That is the same shape as the ok=True-means-accepted defect: the evidence needed to tell the difference is present and unread.
A_DEFECT_IN_MY_INSTRUMENT_FOUND_HERE.status: NOT FIXED during the arc, deliberately -- interval 2 was open. It is carried into Epoch II as an obligation, because a fabricated RED is exactly what the autonomy bar must not accept.

what_this_does_NOT_establish: no repair, no mutation, no landing. Epoch-I G004 remains open and Epoch-II G004 restates it. One honest falsification is not self-repair. What it does establish is that the arc's machinery works when the answer is 'no'.
